title: Weinbrenner deathbed claim of ET bodies in Utah

tellings.quote: there's a lot of research proposed by like Grant Cameron and um Anthony Brigalia and so forth about uh wine Brener on his deathbed saying that they house uh dead extraterrestrials at a facility out in Utah which of course is Dougway proving grounds.

plain: A man named Weinbrenner is said to have claimed on his deathbed that dead extraterrestrials are kept at a facility in Utah, which the teller identifies as Dugway Proving Ground, an Army testing range in the Utah desert. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this as research put forward by the researchers Grant Cameron and Anthony Bragalia. If true, it would mean alien bodies are stored on a US military base.
